question: Which of the following is NOT an element of the Competition Act 2002?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prohibition of trade**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prohibition of trade is not an element of the Competition Act 2002**
 
• **Elements** of the Competition Act 2002
 
 
• **Prohibition of anti-competitive agreements:**
 
 
• The Act prohibits agreements that cause or are likely to cause a significant adverse effect on competition in India.
 
 
 
• **Regulation of combinations: **
 
 
• **​**The Act regulates combinations, such as mergers, amalgamations, and acquisitions.
 
 
 
• **Abuse of dominant position:**
 
 
• **​ **The Act prohibits the abuse of dominant position by enterprises.
 
 
 
• **The Competition Act 2002 aims to: **
 
 
• **​**Foster competition and Protect Indian markets against anti-competitive practices. 
 
 
 
 
 
• The Competition Commission of India (CCI) issues orders to prohibit abuse of dominance and regulate proposed combinations. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The Competition Act includes several definitions which are critical to understanding the act. 

 
• **Acquisition: **

 
 
• **​**Acquisition refers to the agreement, either direct or indirect, to obtain shares, voting rights, or control of assets over any enterprise.
 
 
 
• **Cartel: **
 
 
• **​**A cartel is a group of producers or sellers who control distribution, sale, or promotions of goods through a pre-existing arrangement.
 
 
 
• **Dominant Position: **
 
 
• **​**A dominant position refers to the power held by an enterprise in the related market that allows it to operate independently and influence the market according to its preferences.
 
 
 
• **Predatory Pricing:**
 
 
• **​ **Predatory pricing is a strategy where the price of goods and services is reduced significantly below the cost of production with the intent to eliminate competition.
 
 
 
• **Rule of Reason: **
 
 
• **​**The rule of reason refers to the interpretation of an activity based on business justification, impact on the market competition, and its effect on the consumer.
